name: Shivering Steel (Combat, Technique)
body:
Your weapon’s flexibility lowers foe’s defenses against your tricks as it whips to each edge of their guard.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Weapon Finesse, base attack bonus +2

Benefit(s): When a creature within your finessable weapon’s reach misses you with an attack, you gain a +2 bonus with your next combat maneuver using your wielded weapon against that opponent before the end of your next turn. This benefit only applies once per creature.
